<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>A 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend inputs to include size zeros at MSB
        wire [size-1:0] mul_a_ext = {mul_a, {(size){1'b0}}};
        wire [size-1:0] mul_b_ext = {mul_b, {(size){1'b0}}};
        
        // Generate partial products based on multiplier bits
        genvar i;
        wire [2*size-1:0] pp[0:size-1];
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < size; i=i+1) begin : pp_gen
                assign pp[i] = (mul_b_ext[i]) ? (mul_a_ext << i) : 'd0;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Registers to store intermediate sums
        reg [2*size-1:0] r_reg[0:size-1];
        integer j;
        
        // Adder logic to accumulate partial products
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
                    r_reg[j] <= 'd0;
                end
            end else begin
                for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
                    r_reg[j] <= pp[j][2*size-1:0] + r_reg[j];
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Final product calculation
        reg [2*size-1:0] prod;
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                prod <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                prod <= r_reg[size-1];
            end
        end
        
        // Assign final product to output port
        assign mul_out = prod;
    </implementation>
</module>
